title: Story premise ENT113: The Bench With Room for the Bag
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (positive public good). Hook: One small move makes a seat. Takeaway/theme: A small voluntary adjustment can open shared space.
description: A traveler wants to rest at a crowded toy bus stop, but bags occupy the remaining seats. A waiting passenger notices, moves their own bag to a designated shelf, and others copy the gesture, revealing one free seat without anyone delivering a lecture.
